newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Summaries of games played in the Spanish first division on Saturday:
Compostela 1 (Christopher Ohen 74th minute) Barcelona 5 (William own goal 1st, Giovanni 15th, Ronaldo 35th and 46th, Luis Figo 63rd). Halftime 0-3. Attendance 12,000.
Tenerife 1 (Antonio Robaina 52nd) Valladolid 3 (Alen Peternac 4th, Fernando Sanchez 72nd, Raul Ibanez 86th). 0-1. 15,000.
Atletico Madrid 2 (Juan Carlos Gomez 9th, Diego Simeone 17th) Real Betis 2 (Alfonso Perez 1st, Juan Sabas 86th). 2-1. 37,000.
